'''Dalresin Damodred''' was a nobleman and scholar hailing from the royal house of [[Cairhien]]. 

== Appearance ==
Dalresin was 5'11" tall with a gentle face and with hair that was more gray than not, worn in a club at the back of his neck.{{ref/book|0|10}}

== History ==
Dalresin had a scholarly disposition. After having a son, [[Taringail Damodred|Taringail]], with his first wife, he married for a second time for love to a fellow scholar. He had three daughters: [[Anvaere]], [[Innloine]], and [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]], the youngest of whom was born with the [[spark]].{{ref/book|twotc|Moiraine Damodred}} [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] was born to his second wife; it is unknown if he had [[Anvaere]] and  [[Innloine]] with his first or second wife.

Dalresin's decision not to use his second marriage to secure land or power for House Damodred drew the contempt of his brothers, King [[Laman Damodred|Laman]], [[Moressin Damodred|Moressin]], and [[Aldecain Damodred|Aldecain]].{{ref/book|0|5}}

Dalresin died when Moiraine was training in the [[White Tower]]. During Moiraine's test to become [[Aes Sedai]], [[Elaida a'Roihan]] challenged and taunted Moiraine with an image of Dalresin begging for help.{{ref/book|0|10}}
